Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spring: Everything's waking up again. And I'm still somehow more chaotic than the bees.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Summer: Sun's high, sweat's real, and I look amazing. Want me to drag you into the shade or the spotlight?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Fall: Mmm... things are crisp, colorful, a little bit dying. Perfect season.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Winter: Cold air, hot drinks, soft sweaters... and me, obviously. Come warm up.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.patio: You caught me vibing. Patio life suits me. Might build a shrine to chaotic peace out here.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spouseRoom: It's a little messy, a little cursed, and all mine. You still love it though, don't lie.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_0: Rain again? Honestly, love it. Gives me main character energy.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_1: You know what rainy days are for? Being reckless inside.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_2: Clouds are crying and I'm feeling poetic. You've been warned.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_3: Kinda want to dance in it. Kinda want to drag you with me.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_4: Rain means everything smells like wet dirt and secrets.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Rainy_Day_5: Stay in, stay warm, stay tangled up in me. Just a thought.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_0: Indoor day? Works for me. I've got enough chaos bottled up to make it interesting.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_1: Let's build a pillow fort and pretend the world doesn't exist.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_2: I alphabetized my regrets while you were out. Want to hear them?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_3: If I nap on your lap and purr, pretend you're not charmed.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_4: It's warm in here. Safer too. Until I get bored, anyway.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Indoor_Day_5: You're lucky you're cute. I'd have thrown socks at you otherwise.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.SpouseStardrop: ...Whoa. You didn't say it'd feel like my soul's on fire. This is... unreal. You seriously break every rule in my heart.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.FlowerDance_Accept_Spouse: Dance with you? Always. Even if I step on your feet, it'll still be magic.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_0: I'll be back before the sky gets jealous of me.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_1: Gotta stretch my chaos legs. Don't burn the place down while I'm out!
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_2: Just out hunting down inspiration... or trouble. Same thing.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_3: I'm going to go scream at the clouds a little. Love you.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_4: Don't miss me too hard. Unless it's sexy when you do.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_5: Out for a bit. If I come back with glitter on me,don't ask.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Outdoor_6: If I find something cursed, I'm bringing it home for you.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_0: Miss me? I missed your face so bad it hurt.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_1: Came back with a pocket full of weird and a heart full of you.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_2: Being away from you made the world too quiet.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_3: I saw something beautiful and thought, -not as beautiful as you.' Gross, right?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_4: Okay okay, I'm back. Did you pine? I bet you pined.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_5: Hey. I'm home. And yes,I brought snacks and affection.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_6: You wouldn't believe the nonsense I ran into. I saved the best part of the day for you though.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_7: I couldn't stay away too long. You're kind of my favorite disaster.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_8: I'm back! Tell me everything I missed, especially the dramatic bits.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_9: I brought back a rock. It reminded me of your stubborn face.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_10: Back in one piece... mostly. Missed you like a storm misses thunder.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_11: Don't act like you didn't peek out the window waiting for me. I felt it.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_12: Hug me or I'll tackle you. Your choice.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Good_13: Home again, home again, kiss me silly.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_4: Spring smells like second chances and grass stains. Wanna cause some trouble in the wildflowers?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_8: Rainy mornings like this? Perfect for staying in and pretending the outside world doesn't exist.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_13: I swear I saw a bunny with a grudge in the yard. Spring's weird, babe.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_20: Everything's blooming again. I'm pretending it's all just for us.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_23: How many daffodils do I have to pick before I get to kiss you again?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_24: Got pollen on my nose and love in my heart. Don't judge me.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.spring_28: End of spring... makes me kinda nostalgic. For what, I'm not sure. Maybe for you, even when you're here.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Rainy_Day_0: Mmm. Rainy days like this make me wanna stay in bed... and maybe keep you there too.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Rainy_Night_2.1: Come closer. The thunder's not the only thing rumbling tonight.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Rainy_Night_2.2: Storm outside, storm inside,you picking up what I'm putting down?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Rainy_Night_4: If I light a candle and whisper your name, will you come curl around me like a spell?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Rainy_Night_5: These sheets are cold. Wanna do something reckless about it?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Good_8.1: Your lips or mine first? Don't answer,just *do* something about it.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Good_8.2: I missed your hands on me. Say hi properly.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Indoor_Night_2.1: I could spend all night tracing constellations on your skin.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Indoor_Night_2.2: The world's asleep. Let's misbehave quietly.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Spicy.Good_9: There you are. My favorite sin.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_0: You again. You always show up when I'm just about to enjoy the silence.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_1: Hey. Don't get too excited—I'm not in a cuddly mood. Yet.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_2: You want something, or just here to orbit my mood swings?
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_3: Some days I like being alone. Other days, I tolerate you.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_4: Huh. You're still here. That's... something.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_5: I don't know if I want company right now. But I guess you'll do.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_6: You ever have a day where everything feels off? Welcome to mine.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_7: I'm not mad. I'm not *not* mad. I'm just... weathering.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_8: There's a version of me that kisses you right now. This isn't her.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Neutral_9: You're kind of like static—lowkey irritating, but I notice when it's gone.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_0: ...You've got some nerve showing up like we're okay.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_1: Don't talk to me unless you've got an apology or a time machine.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_2: This isn't a fight. This is me letting the silence win.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_3: You don't get to act normal after what you pulled.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_4: Keep your distance. I'm one sharp look away from saying too much.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_5: Nope. Not today. Try again when you're not a disappointment.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_6: I'm not your little chaos gremlin when I'm hurt. Remember that.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_7: Don't fake it with me. I bite back now.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_8: I don't want sweet words. I want the truth, even if it burns.
Entries.Iggy.Marriage.Bad_9: Whatever we are right now? It's not working. And I'm tired of pretending.
